name: @nerima-games/mc-render
description: Rendering and runtime input for the nerima-games Minecraft-clone rebuild: the post-processing chain, material policy, per-frame scratch buffers, and the InputService.
author: takeokunn

scripts.build: node scripts/clean-dist.mjs && tsc -p tsconfig.release.json --pretty false && tsc -p tsconfig.browser-release.json --pretty false
scripts.lint: oxlint --deny-warnings src apps e2e scripts test playwright.config.ts && ast-grep scan
scripts.lint:fix: oxlint --fix src apps e2e scripts test playwright.config.ts
scripts.test:browser: playwright test --grep-invert 'render preview' && playwright test --grep 'render preview'
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.build.json --pretty false && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --pretty false && tsc -p tsconfig.preview.json --pretty false && tsc -p tsconfig.browser.json --pretty false
scripts.verify: pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm test
